name: sangaline/wayback-machine-scraper
what_it_holds: Generic command-line Scrapy-based utility (and a maintained fork jan-kwiatkowski/wayback-machine-scraper) for crawling a domain's historical snapshots on the Internet Archive Wayback Machine and saving them to disk, by URL pattern and date range.
why_useful: Could, in principle, be pointed at archive.org's captures of insideairbnb.com/get-the-data.html or of the NYC OSE registration-law pages to recover download links/snapshots that predate the Inside Airbnb CDN's ~1-year retention window, filling the pre-2023 / LL18-window archive gap (#1) without touching airbnb.com itself. Not Airbnb-specific and not run by us in this pass -- pure tooling.
license: check repo (commonly MIT/BSD for these forks)
last_activity: actively forked; check individual fork dates
themes: Inside Airbnb New York City snapshots around Local Law 18 (2023-06 to 2024-03) stored in repos
Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: Could, in principle, be pointed at archive.org's captures of insideairbnb.com/get-the-data.html or of the NYC OSE registration-law pages to recover download links/snapshots that predate the Inside Airbnb CDN's ~1-year retention window, filling the pre-2023 / LL18-window archive gap (#1) without touching airbnb.com itself. Not Airbnb-specific and not run by us in this pass -- pure tooling.

More configurable than wayback-machine-downloader for a targeted crawl (e.g. only AirDNA's 'market data' subpages, or Inside Airbnb's per-city summary pages) across many dates at once — useful for gaps #1 and #2.

name: dtrungtin/actor-airbnb-scraper (Apify actor)
what_it_holds: 30-star, 24-fork JavaScript Apify Actor (92 commits) with two modes: destination search (listing URL, name, star rating, guest capacity, address, review summary) and per-listing detail (full reviews with author/timestamp/rating, multi-currency pricing, host info, availability calendar). Runs on the Apify platform (paid credits, ~$1 per 1,000 results); source is open on GitHub.
why_useful: A maintained, currently-listed (GitHub topics surfaced it with April-2026-era activity referenced) scraper-as-a-service for Airbnb — same category as Bright Data: a live scraper of airbnb.com, which is explicitly a ToS decision for a human under our rules, not something to run. Catalogued as method only, unrun.
last_activity: topic page suggests recent (2026) activity in this space
themes: Kaggle-style Airbnb listing snapshot datasets committed to GitHub (any city, any year), especially multi-year or multi-city collections
Airbnb API wrappers and search-page clients (catalogue only, never run): pyairbnb, airbnb-scraper, airbnb search results parsers; note what fields they expose
Airbnb corporate open source (airbnb org) and public data pipelines built on Airbnb-internal-style data; Airbnb Data Science blog notebooks; Airbnb Newsroom scrapers
why_all: A maintained, currently-listed (GitHub topics surfaced it with April-2026-era activity referenced) scraper-as-a-service for Airbnb — same category as Bright Data: a live scraper of airbnb.com, which is explicitly a ToS decision for a human under our rules, not something to run. Catalogued as method only, unrun.

Widely-used hosted-scraper template; the open-source actor code documents the full listing field schema Apify exposes commercially (price, availability, amenities, host, reviews, coordinates) without needing to reverse-engineer Airbnb's API from scratch.

One of the most field-complete Airbnb search+detail scrapers found, and unlike most of the others it explicitly returns an availability calendar alongside multi-currency price — relevant to any future realised-ADR/occupancy reconstruction (gap #2) if a human authorizes running a hosted scraper.

Same class as everythingscraper above — a method for pulling calendar/price data per listing/market that could speak to realized ADR/occupancy (gap #2) or booking lead-time/cancellation patterns (gap #3) if the calendar payload includes booked-vs-available state history. Not run; ToS decision for a human.

name: Chicago/RSocrata
what_it_holds: Official R client (maintained under the City of Chicago GitHub org) for querying any Socrata Open Data portal (SoDA API), handling throttling/pagination and returning an R dataframe. Generic, not STR-specific.

name: traffic
what_it_holds: Mature Python library (1,605 commits, 512 stars, published in JOSS) for pulling and analysing ADS-B/air-traffic trajectory data directly from the OpenSky Network historical database (via Impala/Trino) and Eurocontrol DDR files, with built-in airspace and airport datasets, trajectory cleaning, and visualization (Cartopy, ipyleaflet, altair, CesiumJS). No large committed dataset, but a well-documented, actively used client that dramatically eases historical OpenSky state-vector pulls.
why_useful: If the team wants to nowcast global or route-level flight volumes from OpenSky's historical Impala database (deeper history and finer grain than the pre-built COVID-19 CSV dumps), this is the standard tool academics use to do it -- lowers the acquisition cost for gap #10.
size_hint: library only; pulls are as large as the user's OpenSky query
time_coverage: OpenSky historical DB back to ~2015 (via Impala access, requires a free research account)
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route
why_all: If the team wants to nowcast global or route-level flight volumes from OpenSky's historical Impala database (deeper history and finer grain than the pre-built COVID-19 CSV dumps), this is the standard tool academics use to do it -- lowers the acquisition cost for gap #10.

name: khaeru/sdmx (sdmx1, fork of pandaSDMX)
what_it_holds: Mature Python implementation of SDMX 2.1/3.0 standard (2,570 commits, 47 stars, Apache-2.0), supporting World Bank, IMF, Eurostat, OECD, UN REST services; converts to pandas. This is the successor/fork lineage of the well-known pandaSDMX project.
why_useful: General-purpose but production-grade SDMX client; can hit Eurostat tour_occ/tour_ce and OECD tourism tables, with pandas-native output for a nowcasting pipeline (MIDAS/DFM per gap 17). More actively maintained than the original pandaSDMX.
themes: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE
wildcard: a national tourism-statistics official who knows which agenc
why_all: General-purpose but production-grade SDMX client; can hit Eurostat tour_occ/tour_ce and OECD tourism tables, with pandas-native output for a nowcasting pipeline (MIDAS/DFM per gap 17). More actively maintained than the original pandaSDMX.
